@SpringBootTest(
    webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT,
    properties = ["logging.file.name=build/test-logs/member-service.jsonl"],
)
class MemberServiceApplicationTests {

    @LocalServerPort
    private var port: Int = 0

    private val client = HttpClient.newBuilder().followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NORMAL).build()
    private val json = JsonMapper.builder().build()

    @Test
    fun `OpenAPI JSON describes this service and health endpoint`() {
        val response = get("/v3/api-docs")
        assertEquals(200, response.statusCode())
        val document = json.readTree(response.body())
        assertEquals("3.1.0", document.path("openapi").asString())
        assertEquals("Member Service API", document.path("info").path("title").asString())
        assertEquals("1.0.0", document.path("info").path("version").asString())
        assertEquals("/", document.path("servers").get(0).path("url").asString())
        assertTrue(document.path("paths").path("/actuator/health").path("get").has("responses"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `OpenAPI YAML exposes the same service`() {
        val response = get("/v3/api-docs.yaml")
        assertEquals(200, response.statusCode())
        val document = Yaml().load<Map<String, Any>>(response.body())
        assertEquals("3.1.0", document["openapi"])
        assertEquals("Member Service API", (document["info"] as Map<*, *>)["title"])
    }

    @Test
    fun `H2 console is served`() {
        val response = get("/h2-console/")
        assertEquals(200, response.statusCode())
        assertTrue(response.body().contains("H2 Console"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `Swagger UI is served`() {
        val response = get("/swagger-ui.html")
        assertEquals(200, response.statusCode())
        assertTrue(response.body().contains("Swagger UI"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `health requests preserve a valid request id`() {
        val response = get("/actuator/health", "member-test-request")
        assertEquals(200, response.statusCode())
        assertEquals("UP", json.readTree(response.body()).path("status").asString())
        assertEquals("member-test-request", response.headers().firstValue("X-Request-Id").orElseThrow())
    }

    @Test
    fun `invalid request ids are replaced with UUIDs`() {
        val response = get("/actuator/health", "invalid id")
        val id = response.headers().firstValue("X-Request-Id").orElseThrow()
        assertNotEquals("invalid id", id)
        assertEquals(id, UUID.fromString(id).toString())
    }

    private fun get(path: String, requestId: String? = null): HttpResponse<String> {
        val request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI("http://127.0.0.1:$port$path"))
            .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
        requestId?.let { request.header("X-Request-Id", it) }
        return client.send(request.GET().build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString())

    override fun findPage(query: GetMembersQuery): List<MemberSummary> {
        val rows = Members.select(Members.id, Members.name)

        }

            MemberSummary(it[Members.id], it[Members.name])
        }
    }
}

internal data class GroupMembershipsHttpResponse(val memberships: List<GroupMembershipHttpResponse?>?)
internal data class GroupMembershipHttpResponse(val memberId: String, val group: String, val permission: MembershipPermission)

@Component
class GroupMembershipHttpAdapter(@Qualifier("groupServiceRestClient") private val client: RestClient) : GroupMembershipReadPort {
    private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(javaClass)

    override fun findByMemberIds(memberIds: List<String>): Map<String, GroupMembershipReadModel> {
        if (memberIds.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        try {
            val response = try {
                client.get().uri { uri ->
                    uri.path("/internal/group-members").queryParam("memberIds", memberIds.joinToString(",")).build()
                }.retrieve().body(GroupMembershipsHttpResponse::class.java)
                    ?: throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            } catch (exception: RestClientException) {
                throw classify(exception)
            }
            val entries = response.memberships
                ?: throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            if (entries.any { it == null }) throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            val memberships = entries.filterNotNull().associate { entry ->
                entry.memberId to GroupMembershipReadModel(entry.memberId, entry.group, entry.permission)
            }
            if (memberships.size != entries.size || memberships.keys.any { it !in memberIds }) {
                throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            }
            val durationMs = TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(System.nanoTime() - started)
            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("eventType", "group.lookup.completed")
                .addKeyValue("cqrs", "query").addKeyValue("upstreamService", "group-service")
                .addKeyValue("requestedCount", memberIds.size).addKeyValue("returnedCount", memberships.size)
                .addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
                .log("Group lookup completed (requested={}, returned={}, durationMs={})", memberIds.size, memberships.size, durationMs)
            return memberships
        } catch (exception: GroupMembershipLookupException) {
            log.atWarn().addKeyValue("eventType", "group.lookup.failed")
                .addKeyValue("cqrs", "query").addKeyValue("upstreamService", "group-service")
                .addKeyValue("requestedCount", memberIds.size)
                .addKeyValue("failureReason", exception.reason.name).addKeyValue("upstreamStatus", exception.upstreamStatus)
                .addKeyValue("errorType", exception.cause?.javaClass?.simpleName ?: exception.javaClass.simpleName)
                .addKeyValue("durationMs", TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(System.nanoTime() - started))
                .log("Group lookup failed (reason={}, status={})", exception.reason.name, exception.upstreamStatus)
            throw exception
        }
    }

    private fun classify(exception: RestClientException): GroupMembershipLookupException {
        val reason = when (exception) {
            is RestClientResponseException -> GroupLookupFailureReason.HTTP_ERROR
            is ResourceAccessException -> {
                val timeout = generateSequence<Throwable>(exception) { it.cause }
                    .any { it is HttpTimeoutException || it is SocketTimeoutException }
                if (timeout) GroupLookupFailureReason.TIMEOUT else GroupLookupFailureReason.CONNECTION_FAILURE
            }
            else -> GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE
        }
        return GroupMembershipLookupException(reason, (exception as? RestClientResponseException)?.statusCode?.value(), exception)
    }
}

internal data class GroupMembershipsHttpResponse(val memberships: List<GroupMembershipHttpResponse?>?)
internal data class GroupMembershipHttpResponse(val memberId: String, val group: String, val permission: MembershipPermission)

@Component
class GroupMembershipHttpAdapter(@Qualifier("groupServiceRestClient") private val client: RestClient) : GroupMembershipReadPort {
    private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(javaClass)

    override fun findByMemberIds(memberIds: List<String>): Map<String, GroupMembershipReadModel> {
        if (memberIds.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        try {
            val response = try {
                client.get().uri { uri ->
                    uri.path("/internal/group-members").queryParam("memberIds", memberIds.joinToString(",")).build()
                }.retrieve().body(GroupMembershipsHttpResponse::class.java)
                    ?: throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            } catch (exception: RestClientException) {
                throw classify(exception)
            }
            val entries = response.memberships
                ?: throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            if (entries.any { it == null }) throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            val memberships = entries.filterNotNull().associate { entry ->
                entry.memberId to GroupMembershipReadModel(entry.memberId, entry.group, entry.permission)
            }
            if (memberships.size != entries.size || memberships.keys.any { it !in memberIds }) {
                throw GroupMembershipLookupException(GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE)
            }
            val durationMs = TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(System.nanoTime() - started)
            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("eventType", "group.lookup.completed")
                .addKeyValue("cqrs", "query").addKeyValue("upstreamService", "group-service")
                .addKeyValue("requestedCount", memberIds.size).addKeyValue("returnedCount", memberships.size)
                .addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
                .log("Group lookup completed (requested={}, returned={}, durationMs={})", memberIds.size, memberships.size, durationMs)
            return memberships
        } catch (exception: GroupMembershipLookupException) {
            log.atWarn().addKeyValue("eventType", "group.lookup.failed")
                .addKeyValue("cqrs", "query").addKeyValue("upstreamService", "group-service")
                .addKeyValue("requestedCount", memberIds.size)
                .addKeyValue("failureReason", exception.reason.name).addKeyValue("upstreamStatus", exception.upstreamStatus)
                .addKeyValue("errorType", exception.cause?.javaClass?.simpleName ?: exception.javaClass.simpleName)
                .addKeyValue("durationMs", TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis(System.nanoTime() - started))
                .log("Group lookup failed (reason={}, status={})", exception.reason.name, exception.upstreamStatus)
            throw exception
        }
    }

    private fun classify(exception: RestClientException): GroupMembershipLookupException {
        val reason = when (exception) {
            is RestClientResponseException -> GroupLookupFailureReason.HTTP_ERROR
            is ResourceAccessException -> {
                val timeout = generateSequence<Throwable>(exception) { it.cause }
                    .any { it is HttpTimeoutException || it is SocketTimeoutException }
                if (timeout) GroupLookupFailureReason.TIMEOUT else GroupLookupFailureReason.CONNECTION_FAILURE
            }
            else -> GroupLookupFailureReason.INVALID_RESPONSE
        }
        return GroupMembershipLookupException(reason, (exception as? RestClientResponseException)?.statusCode?.value(), exception)
    }
}

section='''## 멤버 상세·그룹 조회 API

```http
GET /api/member/{memberId}
```

멤버 서버(8080)에서 `memberId`를 영문·숫자 1~32자로 받습니다. 응답 DTO는 `id`, `name`, `email`, `address`, `registeredDate`, `group`을 포함합니다. `group`은 미가입이면 명시적인 `null`, 가입 상태이면 다음 구조입니다.

```json
{
  "id": "dasdxcv22d",
  "name": "최멤버",
  "email": "***",
  "address": "인천광역시",
  "registeredDate": "2026-11-11 02:00",
  "group": {
    "id": "ctwlh136ab",
    "name": "Premium 샘플 그룹",
    "registeredDate": "2026-11-11 01:59",
    "pricing": "Premium",
    "permission": "Admin"
  }
}
```

위 시간은 형식 예시입니다. 모든 날짜는 **UTC 기준 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm`**이며 초·시간대 접미사는 출력하지 않습니다. 멤버의 `registeredDate`는 멤버 생성 시각이고, 중첩된 그룹의 `registeredDate`는 이미지 명세에 따라 **해당 멤버의 그룹 가입 시각**입니다. 그룹 자체의 생성 시각과 구분합니다.

상세 조회는 `GetMemberDetailQueryHandler`가 멤버 DB를 먼저 읽고, 트랜잭션 종료 후 그룹 서버의 `/api/group?memberId=...`를 호출합니다. 없는 멤버는 404이며 그룹 서버를 호출하지 않습니다. 잘못된 ID는 400, 그룹 서버 오류·시간 초과·잘못된 응답은 502입니다.

```sh
curl 'http://localhost:8080/api/member/dasdxcv22d'
curl 'http://localhost:8080/api/member/ev4nmn33ea' # 미가입 멤버
```

그룹 서버(8081)의 단건 조회:

```http
GET /api/group?memberId=dasdxcv22d
```

```json
{
  "memberId": "dasdxcv22d",
  "groupId": "ctwlh136ab",
  "groupName": "Premium 샘플 그룹",
  "registeredDate": "2026-11-11 01:59",
  "pricing": "Premium",
  "permission": "Admin"
}
```

가입 정보가 없으면 상태 200, Content-Type `application/json`, 본문 `null`을 반환합니다. 빈 HTTP 본문이나 404를 미가입으로 취급하지 않습니다.

일괄 조회는 최신 명세의 `/api/group/summary`를 기본으로 사용하며, 최초 명세의 `/api/groups/summary`도 같은 응답을 지원합니다.

```http
GET /api/group/summary?memberIds=ax1qwsd12s,bs8as1vfws
```

```json
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "groupId": "arutjf9348",
      "groupName": "Free 샘플 그룹",
      "totalMemberCount": 2,
      "members": [
        {"memberId": "ax1qwsd12s", "permission": "Admin"},
        {"memberId": "bs8as1vfws", "permission": "Editor"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

`memberIds`는 필수이며 쉼표로 구분한 ID를 1~100개 받습니다. `members`에는 요청한 ID만 포함하고, `totalMemberCount`는 필터와 무관한 그룹 전체 인원수입니다. 미가입 ID는 제외하고, 모두 미가입이면 `{"groups":[]}`입니다. 조회 결과와 전체 인원수는 두 번의 일괄 DB 조회로 가져옵니다.

package com.api.group.api

import com.api.group.api.dto.GroupDetailResponse
import com.api.group.api.dto.GroupsSummaryResponse
import com.api.group.api.dto.toResponse
import com.api.group.application.query.GetGroupByMemberQuery
import com.api.group.application.query.GetGroupInfoQueryHandler
import com.api.group.application.query.GetGroupsSummaryQuery
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Parameter
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
import tools.jackson.databind.node.NullNode

@RestController
@Tag(name = "Groups", description = "멤버 기준 그룹 정보 조회")
class GroupInfoController(private val handler: GetGroupInfoQueryHandler) {
    private val validMemberId = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}")

    @GetMapping("/api/group", produces = [MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE])
    @Operation(summary = "멤버의 그룹 정보 조회", description = "미가입 멤버는 200과 JSON null을 반환합니다. registeredDate는 UTC 기준 그룹 가입 시각입니다.")
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "그룹 가입 정보 또는 null",
        content = [Content(mediaType = "application/json", schema = Schema(implementation = GroupDetailResponse::class))])
    fun findGroup(
        @Parameter(required = true, example = "ax1qwsd12s")
        @RequestParam(name = "memberId") @Pattern(regexp = "[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}") memberId: String,
    ): ResponseEntity<Any> {
        val body: Any = handler.handle(GetGroupByMemberQuery(memberId))?.toResponse() ?: NullNode.instance
        return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(body)
    }

    @GetMapping(value = ["/api/group/summary", "/api/groups/summary"], produces = [MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE])
    @Operation(summary = "멤버 배열로 그룹 요약 조회", description = "groups 안에 그룹별 members를 반환합니다. members는 요청한 멤버만 포함하며 totalMemberCount는 그룹 전체 인원입니다. 미가입 ID는 제외합니다.")
    fun summarizeGroups(
        @Parameter(required = true, description = "쉼표로 구분한 영문·숫자 ID, 최대 100개", example = "ax1qwsd12s,bs8as1vfws")
        @RequestParam(name = "memberIds") memberIds: List<String>,
    ): GroupsSummaryResponse {
        if (memberIds.isEmpty() || memberIds.size > 100 || memberIds.any { !validMemberId.matches(it) }) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "memberIds는 영문·숫자 1~32자의 ID를 1~100개 지정해야 합니다.")
        }
        return handler.handle(GetGroupsSummaryQuery(memberIds)).toResponse()
    }
}
package com.api.group.config

import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.OpenAPI
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.info.Info
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.headers.Header
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.StringSchema
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.ComposedSchema
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.Schema
import org.springdoc.core.customizers.OpenApiCustomizer
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.servers.Server
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
class OpenApiConfiguration {

    @Bean
    fun nullableGroupResponse(): OpenApiCustomizer = OpenApiCustomizer { document ->
        // OpenAPI 3.1 requires an object/null union; nullable on a root $ref is insufficient.
        document.paths?.get("/api/group")?.get?.responses?.get("200")?.content?.get("application/json")?.schema =
            ComposedSchema()
                .addOneOfItem(Schema<Any>().`$ref`("#/components/schemas/GroupDetailResponse"))
                .addOneOfItem(Schema<Any>().types(setOf("null")))
    }

    @Bean
    fun openAPI(): OpenAPI = OpenAPI()
        .info(
            Info()
                .title("Group Service API")
                .version("1.0.0")
                .description("Group 서비스 API 명세")
        )
        .servers(listOf(Server().url("/").description("현재 서비스")))

    @Bean
    fun requestIdResponseHeader(): OpenApiCustomizer = OpenApiCustomizer { document ->
        document.paths?.values?.flatMap { it.readOperations() }?.forEach { operation ->
            operation.responses?.values?.forEach { response ->
                response.addHeaderObject(
                    "X-Request-Id",
                    Header()
                        .description("요청 추적 ID. 유효한 요청 헤더를 유지하거나 서버가 UUID를 생성합니다.")
                        .schema(StringSchema()),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.api.group.api

import com.api.group.api.dto.GroupDetailResponse
import com.api.group.api.dto.GroupsSummaryResponse
import com.api.group.api.dto.toResponse
import com.api.group.application.query.GetGroupByMemberQuery
import com.api.group.application.query.GetGroupInfoQueryHandler
import com.api.group.application.query.GetGroupsSummaryQuery
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Parameter
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Pattern
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
import tools.jackson.databind.node.NullNode

@RestController
@Tag(name = "Groups", description = "멤버 기준 그룹 정보 조회")
class GroupInfoController(private val handler: GetGroupInfoQueryHandler) {
    private val validMemberId = Regex("[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}")

    @GetMapping("/api/group", produces = [MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE])
    @Operation(summary = "멤버의 그룹 정보 조회", description = "미가입 멤버는 200과 JSON null을 반환합니다. registeredDate는 UTC 기준 그룹 가입 시각입니다.")
    @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "그룹 가입 정보 또는 null",
        content = [Content(mediaType = "application/json", schema = Schema(implementation = GroupDetailResponse::class))])
    fun findGroup(
        @Parameter(required = true, example = "ax1qwsd12s")
        @RequestParam(name = "memberId") @Pattern(regexp = "[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}") memberId: String,
    ): ResponseEntity<Any> {
        val body: Any = handler.handle(GetGroupByMemberQuery(memberId))?.toResponse() ?: NullNode.instance
        return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(body)
    }

    @GetMapping(value = ["/api/group/summary", "/api/groups/summary"], produces = [MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE])
    @Operation(summary = "멤버 배열로 그룹 요약 조회", description = "groups 안에 그룹별 members를 반환합니다. members는 요청한 멤버만 포함하며 totalMemberCount는 그룹 전체 인원입니다. 미가입 ID는 제외합니다.")
    fun summarizeGroups(
        @Parameter(required = true, description = "쉼표로 구분한 영문·숫자 ID, 최대 100개", example = "ax1qwsd12s,bs8as1vfws")
        @RequestParam(name = "memberIds") memberIds: List<String>,
    ): GroupsSummaryResponse {
        if (memberIds.isEmpty() || memberIds.size > 100 || memberIds.any { !validMemberId.matches(it) }) {
            throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "memberIds는 영문·숫자 1~32자의 ID를 1~100개 지정해야 합니다.")
        }
        return handler.handle(GetGroupsSummaryQuery(memberIds)).toResponse()
    }
}
package com.api.group.config

import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.OpenAPI
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.info.Info
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.headers.Header
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.StringSchema
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.ComposedSchema
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.media.Schema
import org.springdoc.core.customizers.OpenApiCustomizer
import io.swagger.v3.oas.models.servers.Server
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)
class OpenApiConfiguration {

    @Bean
    fun nullableGroupResponse(): OpenApiCustomizer = OpenApiCustomizer { document ->
        // OpenAPI 3.1 requires an object/null union; nullable on a root $ref is insufficient.
        document.paths?.get("/api/group")?.get?.responses?.get("200")?.content?.get("application/json")?.schema =
            ComposedSchema()
                .addOneOfItem(Schema<Any>().`$ref`("#/components/schemas/GroupDetailResponse"))
                .addOneOfItem(Schema<Any>().types(setOf("null")))
    }

    @Bean
    fun openAPI(): OpenAPI = OpenAPI()
        .info(
            Info()
                .title("Group Service API")
                .version("1.0.0")
                .description("Group 서비스 API 명세")
        )
        .servers(listOf(Server().url("/").description("현재 서비스")))

    @Bean
    fun requestIdResponseHeader(): OpenApiCustomizer = OpenApiCustomizer { document ->
        document.paths?.values?.flatMap { it.readOperations() }?.forEach { operation ->
            operation.responses?.values?.forEach { response ->
                response.addHeaderObject(
                    "X-Request-Id",
                    Header()
                        .description("요청 추적 ID. 유효한 요청 헤더를 유지하거나 서버가 UUID를 생성합니다.")
                        .schema(StringSchema()),
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
